_schema.description: Shared measured parameters. Every leaf is {value, unit, source, date, method, status}. status: 'measured' (raw output exists, cross-validated where possible) or 'inferred' (derived, not directly verified; see note). Only the workstream that measured a number may change it. Readers never edit.
_schema.updated_by: boss (Phase 0 seed); fusion-dispatch added flux_dispatch and flux_dispatch_phase2 2026-09-30

machine.gpu: 8x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (GA100), NVSwitch, all pairs NV12
machine.pcie_link: Gen4 x16 at root port and switch upstream (sysfs); switch-internal unconfirmed (no sudo)

all_to_all_per_gpu_GBps.method: 8 GPUs, each pushes to 7 peers on source-device streams, 1024 MiB/GPU/iter, 20 copies, 5 warmup, 20 repeats, wall-clock median. nsys: 216.5 GB/s per copy, peak concurrency 8.

single_pair_peer_copy_GBps.method: GPU1->GPU0, single stream, 20x256 MiB, CUDA events

per_copy_overhead_regime.note: Below ~1 GiB per GPU per iteration transfer is per-copy-overhead bound; stream count irrelevant. 64 MiB->34.7, 256 MiB->129.6, 1024 MiB->210.9 GB/s per GPU.

h2d_single_gpu_GBps.method: 1024 MiB x20 copies, 5 warmup, 20 repeats, NUMA-local. nvbandwidth cross-check: 21.82.

switch_uplink_pair_h2d_GBps.method: two GPUs on the same switch concurrently; ~= one Gen4 x16 uplink

h2d_uncontended_GBps.method: per-copy classification by whether a D2H overlapped >50% of the copy

h2d_contended_by_d2h_GBps.method: as above; overlap-window method gives 6.164, nvbandwidth gives 8.88 (different duty cycle). Use 6.46 for ring/gateway modelling.
h2d_contended_by_d2h_GBps.note: 3.4x throttle. THE key asymmetry: D2H is immune, H2D collapses.

contention_locus.note: Inferred to be at the GPU endpoint or its switch uplink, not the host memory controller. Direct test is ws/hetero-proxy step 1a. Update this entry with the verdict.

overlap_window_fraction.unit: fraction of span in which both directions are in flight
overlap_window_fraction.note: 57-60%. A wall-clock 'bidirectional' number blends two regimes; do not use one.

pair_same_switch_best_GBps.method: GPU0->GPU1, 1024 MiB, 4 MiB chunk, double-buffered cuStreamWaitValue32

pair_diff_switch_best_GBps.method: GPU0->GPU2, 4 MiB chunk. ~= unidirectional ceiling min(H2D, D2H) = 21.795.

ring8_per_gpu_GBps.method: 0->1->...->7->0, 16 MiB chunk. = 90.9% of contended-H2D ceiling 6.46. Switch-aware ring gives 5.20 (no improvement): every GPU is producer+consumer, so all sit in the contended regime.

ring8_chunk_1mib_aggregate_GBps.note: collapse; use >= 4 MiB when many pairs run concurrently

chain_d2h_leg_in_dualpath_GBps.note: D2H leg of the staging chain while NVLink all-to-all runs concurrently

fixed_overhead_ms.note: Cost of enabling the staging machinery at alpha=0 (streams, events, handshake). ws/hetero-proxy step 1b.

best_case_gain_fraction.note: at alpha ~0.025 with B_nv=217.66, B_d2h=10.9, B_h2d=11.8. Measured: loss at every alpha.

flux_ag_comm_ms._shape: M=4096, K=12288, fp16, world 8; input shard 512x12288 per rank; 100,663,296 output bytes; rank-max median

flux_ag_gemm_ms._shape: M=4096, K=12288, bf16, world 8, weight column-sharded (N/8, K), All2All pull unless noted
flux_ag_gemm_ms._method: interleaved per-round ECT, 200 rounds, SM clock logged, 0 negative ECT in 1200 rounds
flux_ag_gemm_ms._efficiency_definition: (t_serial - t_measured) / (t_serial - t_perfect), t_serial = gemm + comm, t_perfect = max(gemm, comm)

flux_dispatch._method: dispatch_map_v2.py: bf16, TP=8, All2All+use_read, production cuBLAS defaults (init_seed settings undone). Per (layer,M) all items interleaved in one round in random order, >=200 rounds (near-boundary points 350), 128 MB L2 flush before each item, per-round rank-max then median, SM-clock filter. gpu mode = GPU sleep pad + 1-elem NCCL all_reduce alignment, CPU runs ahead (GPU execution time). steady mode = same item x16 back-to-back with distinct weights (eager layer stack).

ag_latency_ms._note: global M rows gathered, bf16. flux = flux.AllGatherOp.run All2All; nccl = dist.all_gather_into_tensor. Source: results/e1_merged_points.csv (layers G-FC1 for K=12288, L-QKV for K=8192).

flux_small_m_floor.note: Flux All2All at M<=64: 8 serial cudaMemcpyAsync on one stream + 2 barriers (src/coll/ths_op/all_gather_op.cc:553-576; nsys results/e2_nsys/parse_G-FC1.txt: ~14 us per copy at M=64)

nccl_ag_M4096_K12288_gpu_aligned_ms.note: vs Phase 0 anchor 0.569 (-16%); host-barrier alignment gives 0.509. Phase 0 claim 'Flux AG 13-22% faster than NCCL at M=1024-16384' holds only for M>=6144 under interleaved measurement. Pending boss ruling.

crossover_ag_gemm._note: verdict per M in gpu mode (steady in report). off = best non-fused path (almost always NCCL+cuBLAS). Non-monotone layers listed with exceptions. Source: reports/20260930_e1_e3_dispatch_map.md section 1.
crossover_ag_gemm.G-FC1 (N=49152,K=12288): off for M<=1032; fused 2048; off 3072 (fallback-config cliff); fused >=4096
crossover_ag_gemm.L-GU (N=57344,K=8192): off for M<=1032 (ties at 512,1024); tie 2048; fused 3072; off 4096 (registry-config cliff); fused >=6144

sustained_load_sm_clock_mhz.note: 400 W power limit, no cap set. Short/padded runs sit at 1410 MHz. Phase 0 (1155-1200 MHz) was measured in this regime.

cublas_under_flux_testing_init_seed.note: flux.testing.initialize_distributed() -> init_seed(): CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:16:8 makes torch.mm host launch 13 -> 71 us; disabling bf16 reduced-precision reduction adds up to +26% GPU time on some shapes. Undo before measuring any cuBLAS baseline.

cuda_graph_capture.flux_agkernel_forward: NOT capturable: capturing stream has unjoined work (cp_stream copies never joined; src/ag_gemm/ths_op/all_gather_gemm_op.cc:271-276)

gemm_rs_crossover.L-O (N=8192,K=8192): off for M<=16; mostly tie 24-264; Flux GemmRS wins from M=256 (up to 30% at M=16384)
gemm_rs_crossover.L-down (N=8192,K=28672): off for M<=24; mostly tie 32-264; Flux GemmRS wins from M=256
gemm_rs_crossover.G-O (N=12288,K=12288): off for M<=16; tie 24-256; Flux GemmRS wins from M=264
gemm_rs_crossover.G-FC2 (N=12288,K=49152): off for M<=72; tie 128-256; Flux GemmRS wins from M=264

block_level_llama70b_4blocks.method: 4 Llama-3-70B blocks, fused Triton RMSNorm/SiLU*up, 200 interleaved rounds, rank-max median; layout chosen from calibration run seed 20260930
block_level_llama70b_4blocks.op_table_predicts_block_delta: prefill median rel err 5.5%, decode graph 9.0%, no sign errors; eager small-M decode fails (118%, 9 sign errors, CPU launch bound)

ag_latency_triton_prototype_us.note: complete AllGather = parallel system-scope flag barrier + one P2P-load gather kernel (Triton); own shard assumed already in the IPC buffer. Epoch passed from host (not graph-safe yet).

flux_sync_overhead_us_at_M8.note: flux_default 98.7 - same 7 copies on one stream without sync 38.3

block80_over_20x_block4.note: c10d NCCL collectives get more expensive per op in long CUDA graphs [inferred]; vLLM custom AR scales linearly

nccl_vs_flux_ag_clock_dependence.note: Phase 0 script measures NCCL while SM is at 1155 MHz (light load after idle): NCCL 0.565 ms at M=4096 K=12288; at 1410 MHz 0.475. Flux All2All (copy engine) ~0.47 in both. NCCL is SM-clock sensitive, Flux AG is not [inferred from timing correlation; clocks cannot be locked without sudo].

triton_ag_prototype_correctness.note: skew between barrier and gather; double buffering by epoch parity required

overlap._note: ws/diag-overlap writes signal-arrival / CTA-start distributions and any recovered overlap numbers here.

flux_dispatch_g1._status: derived from existing measurements (model fit, no new GPU runs); NOT yet audited

fused_ag_kernel_start_us.method: least-squares line of GEMM-kernel start after the first copy vs local shard bytes

fused_ag_d_tail_ms.method: median of (Flux AG + gemm_only - fused) over shapes where one tile row spans all shards (no overlap possible): fixed cost the fused op saves

fused_ag_overlap_rule.value: Flux sm80 AGKernel hides communication only when the CUTLASS stream-K schedule leaves late-arriving rows to later waves; with the fallback stream-K config this needs > ~1.5 waves of work (here M >= 3072); data-parallel configs overlap earlier
fused_ag_overlap_rule.status: inferred (code + schedule simulation; matches nsys V8 and E1 D-A)
fused_ag_overlap_rule.evidence: schedule model fed with measured components: fused-time median error 0.8% (gpu) / 1.6% (steady); unseen P0-4096 M=4096 hidden 3% vs measured 7%, P0-8192 M=4096 70% vs 65%
fused_ag_overlap_rule.how_to_verify: nsys per-CTA start times, or force a data-parallel RasterAlongN config for P0-4096 (predicted fused 0.54-0.58 ms vs measured 0.681)

flux_registry_pcie_section_configs.value: registry entries under '// PCIE' win (emplace, first entry); on this NVLink machine their GEMM is 1.23-1.58x cuBLAS at G-FC1 M=1024, L-QKV M=4096, L-GU M=4096
flux_registry_pcie_section_configs.status: measured (GEMM times, results/final_ag_points.csv); 'tuned for PCIe' is inferred from the section heading

predictor_op_regret_pct._note: op-level regret of the predictor alone (no probes), AG / RS side; test rows never used for fitting

flux_dispatch_g2._status: measured (calibration microbenchmarks, exclusive_guard CLEAN) + derived (model fit); NOT yet audited

hw_profiles.method: predictor fitted ONLY from calibrate_hw_v1.py microbenchmarks (shapes avoid all evaluation layers and Flux registry entries)

calibration_wall_clock_min.method: 6 processes (comm, 3 AG shapes, 2 RS shapes), gpu+steady modes, including process start-up

flux_allgather_sync_ms.method: gpu mode, median over M<=64 of c_flux_ag - 8/7 * (7 serial peer copies); G1 got 0.0533 from F2 data

predictor_op_regret_pct_all_320_points._note: calibration-only profiles, predictor alone (pred) and with probes (hyb+pcie), AG / RS side

flux_dispatch_g3._status: measured (op maps, guard CLEAN) vs pre-registered predictions; NOT yet audited

flux_allgather_sync_ms_by_tp.method: gpu mode, median over M<=64 of c_flux_ag - W/(W-1) * (W-1 serial peer copies), per-TP calibration
flux_allgather_sync_ms_by_tp.note: not a constant: ~proportional to log2(TP) [inferred from 3 points]

preregistered_op_regret_pct._note: predictor alone, AG / RS; 320 points, predictions pushed before measuring (642bf6a)

cublas_cliffs.value: cuBLAS is up to 22-53% slower than the roofline+tile model at specific shape x M (e.g. TP2 n=14336 K=4096 M=136; TP8 n=3584 K=4096 M=1024)

posthoc_measured_gemm_diag.value: measured standalone GEMMs + modelled comm/overlap: AG regret 0.27% (vs 1.76% model-only)
